architecture_contract.method: two modality-specific variational autoencoders with partial-correspondence aggregation, reconstruction, and opposite-decoder cross-modal imputation
architecture_contract.training_correspondence: An explicit correspondence matrix P may encode validated pairs or partial pairs; otherwise JAMIE estimates correspondence from the training data. If equally sized modalities are supplied without P, the code assumes identity correspondence.
architecture_contract.training_objective: mean-squared reconstruction plus latent alignment/correspondence losses and KL regularization

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No upstream checkpoint is admitted. Fit one project model inside each outer donor fold and seed and export controlled tensor state plus preprocessing state.
implementation.package_registry_warning: The exact v4.3.2 source revision has no matching PyPI release. PyPI package JAMIE 0.1.3 points to PotatoXi/Jamie and is unrelated; it must never be substituted.
implementation.source_license_finding: The exact repository root contains GPL-3.0 text. setup.py declares no license. The current shared registry's repository-GPL/package-MIT conflict is unsupported for this revision and should be replaced with GPL-3.0-only.

inductive_inference_contract.allowed_cell_wrapper: Apply the frozen source-modality preprocessing and call transform_one for the RNA modality in eval/no-grad mode. This returns the posterior mean through fc_mus and requires no target ATAC or query optimization.
inductive_inference_contract.allowed_cross_decode: modal_predict applies the frozen source preprocessing, RNA encoder, posterior mean when the model is in eval mode, opposite ATAC decoder, and frozen target inverse preprocessing. It needs no held ATAC and performs no query fitting.
inductive_inference_contract.forbidden: Do not call fit_transform, match, transform with a second query modality, or any correspondence estimation on held or sealed rows. Do not rely on equal row counts to infer pairing. Do not update PCA, scaling, BatchNorm, dropout state, model parameters, heads, or calibration on queries.
inductive_inference_contract.required_state: The project adapter must call model.eval explicitly. edModelVar samples its posterior while in training mode; eval mode uses the posterior mean.

input_contract.atac_input: A frozen ordered GRCh38.p14 peak matrix transformed by a prospectively defined assay-native training recipe before JAMIE's generic PCA/scaling stage
input_contract.feature_alignment: Frozen GENCODE v49 genes and GRCh38.p14 0-based half-open peaks. The source and target feature orders and every PCA/scaling parameter are part of the checkpoint.
input_contract.native_preprocessing: With default pca_dim, each modality fits PCA on training rows and preclass then uses one global mean and standard deviation over the training PCA matrix because axis=None. With PCA disabled, preclass uses per-feature axis=0 moments. Actual dimensions are data-dependent unless frozen explicitly.
input_contract.rna_query_from_raw_counts: The project adapter must convert held raw UMI counts using the prospectively frozen assay recipe, such as per-cell total normalization and log1p, then apply only training-fitted PCA and preclass transforms. JAMIE itself is a generic continuous-data MSE model and is not a count-likelihood model.

missingness_contract.inference: RNA-only prediction calls transform_one or modal_predict with the RNA matrix alone; no target ATAC placeholder is created.
missingness_contract.project_mapping: Retain all eight project missingness states outside JAMIE. Missing target ATAC is structural absence, never a zero matrix.
missingness_contract.training: Modalities may contain unequal or partially matched cell sets, but every known correspondence must be explicit and confined to outer-training data.

output_contract.cell_embedding: deterministic RNA posterior mean from transform_one after model.eval, with the exact latent dimension recorded
output_contract.cross_modal_output: modal_predict returns the ATAC decoder output after inverse standardization and inverse PCA in the chosen target input scale
output_contract.profile_limitation: The inverse-transformed ATAC output is an unbounded continuous vector and may contain negative values. It is suitable for prespecified rank, correlation, retrieval, or integration diagnostics, not the primary nonnegative multinomial/profile-deviance endpoint.
output_contract.profile_status: latent_or_secondary_rank_only. Clipping, softplus, shifting, or row normalization would create a new project projection not supplied by JAMIE and cannot be selected using held outcomes.

safe_loading_contract.upstream_risk: save_model serializes the complete model with torch.save and load_model calls unrestricted torch.load. The .h5 example suffix does not make this an HDF5 tensor format.
safe_loading_contract.required_adapter: Restore only project-controlled tensor state and explicit architecture/PCA/preclass manifests after exact hash and key/shape/dtype validation. Never load an external JAMIE model object.

source_evidence: The exact JAMIE v4.3.2 tag, immutable source, GPL-3.0 repository license, setup metadata, declared environment, unrelated PyPI name collision, and primary paper were inspected on 2026-08-22. No package, dependency, checkpoint, weight, dataset, or serialized object was downloaded, installed, loaded, trained, or executed.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Eligible in principle through transform_one on a locally trained frozen RNA path after raw-query preprocessing, explicit-pairing, eval-state, runtime, loading, and leakage fixtures pass.
task_fit.development_only_integration: Eligible as a separately reported native integration diagnostic when all correspondence estimation is confined to the declared training/development population.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Remove from the primary profile leaderboard. Retain only a prespecified secondary rank/correlation diagnostic unless a new training-only nonnegative projection and TaskSpec are approved before outcomes are viewed.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible because JAMIE has no DNA sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
